verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows the API returning a readable per-result relevance score that a developer could threshold on. The closest item is the LLM Context endpoint's server-side 'adjustable threshold modes' (docs-58). That is an adjacent control: Brave applies the cutoff itself rather than exposing scores, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-result relevance scores to threshold what enters my pipeline
